commands:
echo "plugin version:"; jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json
echo "=== regenerate contract and diff against committed ==="
python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py generate > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.json 2>.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.err; echo "gen-rc=$?"
diff scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.json && echo "ARTIFACT-MATCHES-REGEN" || echo "ARTIFACT-DIFFERS"
head -5 .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/reg …[per-command-truncated]

echo "plugin version:"; jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json
python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py generate 2>.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.err | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.json >/dev/null; echo "pipe done"
diff scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.json && echo "ARTIFACT-MATCHES-REGEN" || echo "ARTIFACT-DIFFERS"
echo "err:"; head -5 .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1296/local-run/regen.err

echo "plugin version:"; jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json
REGEN=$(python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py generate 2>&1); echo "gen-rc=$?"
printf '%s\n' "$REGEN" | diff scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json - && echo "ARTIFACT-MATCHES-REGEN" || echo "ARTIFACT-DIFFERS"

echo "=== plugin version at this commit ==="; jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json
echo "=== pairing-2 invariant + regen consistency ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, hashlib, io, contextlib
m = json.load(open('scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json'))
req = set(m['required_helper_heads']['implement'])
src = open('lib/test/test_python_scripts.py').read()
mobj = re.search(r'"implement":\s*\{(.*?)\},\n', src, re.S)
block = mobj.group(1)
frozen = set(".prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/"+n …[per-command-truncated]

git stash list; git diff --stat; echo "=== run focused cloud-writer test ==="; timeout 300 lib/test/test_python_scripts.py 2>&1 | grep -iE "AC18|AC19|pairing|legacy|FAIL|cloud.writer|frozen" | head -40

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
